I will do this plot the way I know and the way women around me manage when money is tight. This maize land is mine, so I will feed it with dung from home, but for bought fertilizer I will use only a little because cash is hard and I do not want debt at my age. I will keep local seed that I trust, I will not irrigate because I farm with the rain, and I will use family work first and only bring a few people when work is heavy.
